description: Signed model routing between the peer and the Master. The request is data-plane only; it grants no authority and no local knowledge read.

request.model: a logical alias registered in the resource directory
request.payload: an OpenAI-compatible chat/completions or embeddings body

response.result: the upstream OpenAI-compatible response, never merged with local knowledge

rules: A user-class request never crosses the bridge.
The caller is verified by the shared signed transport and model-route/Master authority.
Remote results carry source_node and model provenance.
No model route writes a vault, ledger, registry or memory record.
